_comment: Official Xylella fastidiosa status of every country around the Mediterranean (plus Portugal and Jordan), from the EPPO Global Database distribution table checked on the date below. 'category' drives the map colour: present / absent (confirmed by an official survey) / no_record (EPPO lists nothing, which is NOT the same as confirmed absence). The weekly EPPO check opens a GitHub issue when EPPO's status for one of these countries changes, so this file can be updated by hand. 'lat'/'lon' place a fallback marker if the country outline can't be loaded.

countries.name: Portugal
countries.note: Outbreaks under eradication in Norte, Centro, Lisboa and Algarve.

countries.name: Spain
countries.note: Containment in the Balearics; mainland outbreaks in Alicante and Extremadura under eradication.

countries.name: France
countries.note: Corsica, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur and Occitanie; several Occitanie areas moved to containment in 2025.

countries.name: Italy
countries.note: Containment in Puglia; outbreaks in Tuscany, Lazio, Basilicata and (since 2026) Calabria.

countries.name: Malta
countries.note: EU member: annual official surveys are mandatory under Regulation (EU) 2020/1201; no demarcated area listed.

countries.name: Croatia
countries.note: EU member: annual official surveys are mandatory; no demarcated area listed.

countries.name: Greece
countries.note: EU member under mandatory annual surveys; a 2025 Greek olive-congress abstract states it has not been detected in Greece.

countries.name: Lebanon
countries.note: Subsp. fastidiosa on almond in Bint Jbeil district, found in late summer 2020 (EPPO 2023/113).

countries.name: Israel
countries.note: Subsp. fastidiosa on almond in the Hula Valley, reported from 2017 (EPPO 2019/121, 2022/013).

countries.name: Egypt
countries.note: Covered by FAO's Near East and North Africa prevention programme (2016).

countries.name: Tunisia
countries.note: Hosted the EPPO/NEPPO Xylella contingency exercise in Hammamet in May 2025.

countries.name: Algeria
countries.note: A vector of Xylella in the Americas (Graphocephala versuta) was first found here in 2022 (EPPO 2022/191).
